title.description: Title of the feedback sheet header.

fab_label.description: Accessibility label for the help/feedback button that opens the feedback sheet.

close_label.description: Accessibility label for the button that closes the feedback sheet.

type_label.description: Label above the bug/feature type selector.

type_bug.description: Option label for reporting a bug in the feedback type selector.

type_feature.description: Option label for requesting a feature in the feedback type selector.

label_title.description: Label above the feedback title text field.

label_description.description: Label above the feedback description text field.

placeholder_title.description: Placeholder text in the feedback title field.

placeholder_description.description: Placeholder text in the feedback description field.

submit.description: Submit button label on the feedback form.

submit_success.description: Success message shown after feedback is submitted.

submit_error.description: Error message shown when feedback submission fails.

submit_error_rate_limit.description: Error message shown when the player has hit the feedback rate limit.

error_title_required.description: Validation error shown when the feedback title field is left empty.

error_description_required.description: Validation error shown when the feedback description field is left empty.
